Name: Fatter Cat - Calico (Content Patcher Compatible)
Author: LuxLib
Description:
I wanted to add my calico cat to the game. She's an absolute unit and her orb form was something I missed. I remedied this by making the default cat fatter and calico!

If you have another coat pattern that you are interested in, please let me know!

[code][size=5]Install[/size]
Content Patcher[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

XNB - Not Content Patcher[list=1]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley[/font]
[*]Run Stardew Valley as you normally do.
[/list]
[/code]

Downloads.Description: Contains both Content Patcher and XNB files.
